fullDescription: A clean, mobile-first management system landing page featuring a professional dashboard aesthetic. Using a high-energy primary red (#e11d48) against a crisp white and slate palette, the design is optimized for retail operations, SaaS platforms, and fintech solutions. Key characteristics include an editorial typography hierarchy using Nunito, bento-style feature cards, and high-contrast dark-mode preview components to simulate a live application environment.
prompt:
## Resumo
A professional and efficient retail-focused management landing page with a mobile-first layout. It utilizes a bold red accent to drive action, balanced by soft blue-grays and a sophisticated dark-slate dashboard preview that establishes immediate product credibility.

## Estilo Visual
Create a design system with the following specs: Font: 'Nunito', sans-serif. Colors: Primary Red (#e11d48), Background (#fafbfe), Surface White (#ffffff), Text Foreground (#5b6670), Border Soft (#e2e8f0), Link Slate (#64748b). Typography: H1 (30px, 800 weight, 1.2 line-height), H2 (22px, 800 weight, 1.3 line-height), Body (13px, 600 weight, 1.6 line-height), Button Text (14px, 400 weight). Elements: Use 12px to 24px corner radii (rounded-xl to rounded-3xl). Shadows: Buttons use `box-shadow: 0 10px 15px -3px rgba(225, 29, 72, 0.2)`. Animations: Use `active:scale-95` for buttons and smooth transitions for hover states.

## Layout e Estrutura

### Navigation Header
Height: 56px (plus top safe area). Background: White. Border-bottom: 1px solid #e2e8f0. Left side: Logo combo with an 8x8 rounded-lg red icon (#e11d48) and bold text (18px). Right side: 40x40px square icon-button with a hamburger menu icon.

### Hero Section
Padding: 40px top/bottom, 20px sides. Background: White. Top-aligned pill badge: Rose-50 background, Rose-600 text, 11px bold uppercase. Headline: 30px bold H1. CTA Group: Stacked buttons. Primary button is Red (#e11d48) with white text and an arrow icon; Secondary button is White with Border (#e2e8f0) and Steel gray text.

### Dashboard Preview Component
Layout: Negative margin-top (-24px) to overlap the hero. Background: Slate-900 (#0f172a). Padding: 16px. Contents: Top bar with traffic light window controls (Red, Amber, Green) and a 'Live' badge. Two-column grid showing metrics with Slate-800/50 backgrounds and thin white/5 borders. Emerald-400 text for success metrics.

### Feature Grid
Padding: 48px top/bottom. Structure: Vertical list of cards. Card style: White background, 1px #e2e8f0 border, 16px padding, rounded-2xl. Layout: Left-aligned icon box (48x48px) with pastel backgrounds (Rose-50, Blue-50, Emerald-50) paired with right-aligned text content (16px bold header + 13px body).

### Trust Stats Banner
Background: Solid #e11d48. Padding: 48px vertical. Two-column grid. Contents: Large 32px extra-bold white percentages/numbers over 11px uppercase bold Rose-200 subtitles with wide letter-spacing (tracking-widest).

### Final CTA Card
Padding: 48px vertical, 20px sides. Centerpiece: A rounded-3xl white card with a subtle border. Contents: H2 heading, body text, full-width primary red button, and a text link with an underline offset-4 and rose-200 decoration.

## Componentes Especiais de UI

### Dashboard Mini-Card — High-fidelity dark mode metrics card
Create a 150px wide metric card. Background: rgba(30, 41, 59, 0.5). Border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05). Corner radius: 12px. Label: 10px text-slate-400. Value: 16px font-bold text-white. Include a subtle glow effect.

### Action Button with Glow — Primary call-to-action with colored drop shadow
Background-color: #e11d48. Text: #ffffff. Border-radius: 12px. Padding: 16px 24px. Box-shadow: 0 20px 25px -5px rgba(225, 29, 72, 0.2). On active: transform scale(0.98).

style.description: The style is 'Professional Utility,' pairing the Nunito font family (weights 400, 600, 800) with a modern retail color palette. Primary accent: #e11d48 (Rose-600); Background: #fafbfe (Off-white blue); Text: #5b6670 (Steel gray); Borders: #e2e8f0. Buttons use heavy drop shadows (shadow-rose-200) and scale-down micro-interactions on click. Typography is extremely structured: H1s are 30px bold, while body text is a legible 13px semi-bold.
